# Quality backlog

Search `reference.md` section `05` for the relevant Q-item before adding work
or declaring completion. Preserve status and acceptance gates.

Feature hardening covers parser/validation, layout, shared scene/plan,
applicable encoders, malformed input, determinism, diagnostics, tests, and
docs. “Implemented” is not “complete” while these remain unverified.
